name: Dark Chocolate Tofu Mousse
ingredients: 40 g dark chocolate (85% cocoa or higher), melted
steps: Melt the chocolate gently in the microwave in 20-second bursts, stirring each time; cool slightly.
Blend the tofu, melted chocolate, cocoa, banana, vanilla and salt until completely smooth.
note: High-cocoa chocolate has little sugar; the tofu provides protein and a creamy texture.
